items.text: Representative native plans and their revisions remain visible and interactive under REQ-001, with the required behavior preserved irrespective of the assessed registry implementation. Verify using VER-001.

verification.text: Replay selected-version native plan items and revisions through the views and inspect the person's planning/revision interaction. Compare the displayed plan and revision sequence with the source items, including updated content. Retain candidate-bound fixture/input identities and observations for AC-001. Sources: D verification; P V4-APP-01/04; E local V4-EXM-10 observations.

items.text: Representative substantive tool activity and successful, failed or unavailable outcomes render from native items under REQ-002; missing observations remain unknown and no Chirality event translation supplies invented meaning. Verify using VER-002.

verification.text: Replay recorded substantive native tool activity and observed success/failure/unavailable-result cases. Compare displayed activity/outcomes with the native source, inspect the presentation path for event renaming/semantic translation, and confirm unavailable outcomes are still unknown. Record evidence for AC-002. Sources: D; A V4-ARC-05; E V4-EXM-02/11.

items.text: Representative delegated work retains native descendant identity/activity and the fleet receiving seam under REQ-003, including a completed primary turn with an active descendant. No unobserved return, review or integration is inferred. Verify using VER-003.

verification.text: Exercise a native delegated-work fixture and its receiving identity linkage, including a primary-turn completion while a descendant remains active. Compare source identities/activity to both local display and the defined fleet seam; inspect for invented return/review/integration completion. Record evidence for AC-003. Sources: D; A §3; E V4-EXM-11/13 local observations.

items.text: Presented selected-version identity and the native types/fixtures correspond to the supplied supplier basis under REQ-004, and a missing or mismatched basis cannot be reported as verified compatibility. Verify using VER-004.

verification.text: Compare visible supplier version and fixture/type identities with the actual supplier input from CLM-002. Exercise missing/mismatched identity evidence and verify it is not reported as confirmed compatibility. Record the supplier qualification reference and this slice's observation separately for AC-004. Sources: D SOW-128/local verification; A §3; O OI-012/DEP-005.

items.text: Tool execution alone produces no invented human acceptance, checking, approval or professional-reliance status; a separately evidenced actual human act can be faithfully shown with its decision actor distinct from the recorder and its content/scope/purpose intact under REQ-005. Verify using VER-005.

verification.text: Inspect presentation fixtures for (a) execution success without any human-act evidence, (b) an attempted inference of approval/reliance from a session entry and (c) a separately evidenced human act with identified actor, content, scope and purpose recorded by the system/agent. Verify negatives do not fabricate an act and the positive faithfully renders the actual actor/recorder distinction. Use synthetic material for fixtures; do not report synthetic acts as real owner decisions. Confirm no invented acceptance-first ordering for independently evidenced acts. Record evidence for AC-005. Sources: P V4-AUT-03/05 and V4-REC-03/05; H decision 03; I §5.

items.text: The feature/reuse map covers all assigned scope and anticipated artifacts, preserves required behavior while recording conditional reuse, and resolves the enumerated exclusions to their named owners under REQ-006/007. Open means and policy stay assigned to their actual decision owners and points of need. Verify using VER-006.

verification.text: Review the native feature/reuse map against D's assigned scope, artifacts and interfaces, H's conditional-reuse clarification, CLM-001…004 and the O issue rows. Trace each excluded act in REQ-007 to its cited actual owner; check local versus joint contributions, required behavior versus reuse choices, and each retained choice's point of need. Record evidence for AC-006.

items.text: The pinned-native-item fixture set and its reported results meet REQ-008 and account for the local plan/tool/delegation observations without claiming the full workflow-making, fleet or host journey passed. Verify using VER-007.

verification.text: Inspect fixture provenance and the candidate/configuration/date/outcome record, confirm coverage of AC-001…005 and cross-engine/native evidence under REQ-008, and mark unavailable witnesses with their actual status. Confirm local fixture results are not advertised as full workflow-making/fleet/host qualification. Record evidence for AC-007. Sources: D; E §1–3; O OI-015.
